Context: 1. General Principles

14. PermaneRtly incapacitated Government servants not to be invalided. A Government servant who has been permanently incapacitated from Government service on account of mental or physical disability shall not be invalided or reduced in rank. If he is not suitable for the present post, he could be shifted to some other post with the same pay scale and service benefits.
